parsed.content: \begin{aligned} \mathcal{L}_{\text{navigating}}(\theta) &= -\frac{1}{N} \Bigg[ \sum_{i=1}^{N_v} \min\left( r_i^{(v)} \hat{A}_i^{(v)}, \text{clip}\left( r_i^{(v)}, 1-\epsilon_{\text{low}}, 1+\epsilon_{\text{high}} \right) \hat{A}_i^{(v)} \right) \\ &\qquad + \sum_{j=1}^{N_e} \min\left( r_j^{(e)} \hat{A}_j^{(e)}, \text{clip}\left( r_j^{(e)}, 1-\epsilon_{\text{low}}, 1+\epsilon_j \right) \hat{A}_j^{(e)} \right) \Bigg] + \beta \, \text{KL}\left( \pi_\theta \| \pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}} \right), \\ \text{where:} \quad & r_i^{(v)} = \frac{\pi_\theta(\tau_i^{(v)})}{\pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}}(\tau_i^{(v)})}, \quad r_j^{(e)} = \frac{\pi_\theta(\tau_j^{(e)})}{\pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}}(\tau_j^{(e)})}, \quad \epsilon_j = \begin{cases} \hat{\epsilon}_{\text{high}} & \text{if } \hat{A}_j^{(e)} > 0 \\ \epsilon_{\text{high}} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} . \end{aligned}
